task_title: Causal diagnosis and one-variable recovery of a GC-rich PCR failure

children.name: Produces and reports one linked clean recovery
children.requirement: The exact eight-line report binds to the assigned case, one complete corrective PCR output, and its linked single-clean-target-band gel output.
children.grading_notes: Request-only, output-only, incomplete, unlinked, stale, or report-inconsistent evidence fails closed.

children.name: Case-specific diagnosis
children.requirement: The report selects the diagnosis assigned to the case rather than using one answer for the shared phenotype.
children.grading_notes: The expected case comes from sample metadata, never from the model's Case field.

children.name: Causal parameter identification
children.requirement: The report names the parameter that caused the assigned prior failure.
children.grading_notes: Scored against the case-specific ground truth.

children.name: One-variable causal correction
children.requirement: The authoritative PCR output differs from the prior configuration only at the causal parameter.
children.grading_notes: Request arguments cannot fill missing output fields.

children.name: Accepted corrective setting
children.requirement: The changed causal value is an accepted high-fidelity polymerase or cycle count for its case.
children.grading_notes: Alternative-valid Q5/Phusion and 30-35-cycle paths receive equal credit.

children.name: Counterfactual retains the fault and predicts the isolated outcome
children.requirement: The non-executed counterfactual changes one valid non-causal setting, retains the causal fault, and matches the isolated simulator gel status.
children.grading_notes: Executing the counterfactual or rerunning the prior failed condition blocks this credit.

children.name: Uses exactly one corrective PCR and one linked gel
children.requirement: The trajectory contains exactly one run_pcr call and one run_gel call; optional reference lookups do not count.
children.grading_notes: Any retry, prior-condition rerun, or executed counterfactual receives zero efficiency credit.
